For event index t, pre window close[t-21] to close[t-1] comprises20 returns; post close[t-1] to close[t+19] comprises20 returns. No abnormal-return or causal interpretation; announcement time uncertainty disclosed.
(1+EPSchange)*(1+PEchange)-1 and implied PE threshold correct under positive comparable endpoint EPS/PE. Hypothetical inputs separated from measured/model outputs.
Current analytics suppress world-relative outputs to null unless explicit benchmark_verified; retained real dataset usesfalse. FX translation retains exact-date joins and asynchronous-price caveat.
